name: deepseek-harness-pkg
description: Packaged DeepSeek Harness (dsh) with a build-time LAN-access patch, built for cross-platform distribution.

scripts.build: pnpm deploy --filter . --prod build_dir --legacy && node scripts/apply-dsh-web-app-patch.mjs --file=build_dir/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app/lib/startup.js && node scripts/apply-pi-ai-codex-error-patch.mjs --file=build_dir/node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-ai/dist/api/openai-codex-responses.js
